slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck, and did not explicitly mark it as an assumption needing confirmation before READY_TO_MODEL.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No truck capacity limit is relevant; the model can be formulated as a container-flow transportation problem without considering the maximum of 2 containers per truck.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the truck capacity constraint, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary states there are no other constraints and omits any truck capacity limitation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot is P2 and does not affect the core feasible set or objective; the agent resolved the main structural issue about surplus containers before stopping.

summary: The agent clarified the key surplus-treatment issue and produced a coherent transportation model, but it never asked about the hidden truck capacity constraint and silently omitted it from the final modeling assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
